invariants: Same 3:1 panorama, camera, horizon, skyline, buildings, mountains and road; preserve detailed lightly illustrated realistic style; no window frames, text or panels.

variants.summer-morning: Early morning warm gold on facades, cool lavender shadows, peach and pale blue sky, leafy trees, lights mostly off.
variants.summer-day: Bright neutral overhead midday sun, pale blue sky with white clouds, short shadows, green trees, street and apartment lights off.
variants.summer-night: Full darkness, navy sky, small crescent moon and faint stars, dark mountains, irregular warm apartment lights, streetlights and headlights.
variants.winter-morning: Snow on roofs, ground, mountains, cars and bare branches; all deciduous trees leafless, no green or autumn foliage; cool pale blue and gold sunrise, lights mostly off.
variants.winter-day: Snowy winter midday, cold pale blue sky, white clouds, short cool shadows, snow-covered roofs, ground and bare branches, lights off.
variants.winter-evening: Snowy sunset, peach and mauve sky, violet-blue snow shadows, bare snowy branches, lights just turning on.
variants.winter-night: Snowy full night, navy cloudy sky and moonlit opening, blue moonlight and warm streetlights reflected on snow, bare snowy branches.

postprocessing: Lossy WebP compression only, original generated composition and dimensions retained.
precipitation: Not baked into scenery. Irregular layered shader snow and refracting rain beads animate only inside window planes.
